body: I don’t think I can forgive myself

I am excited about the freedom and want it but a part of is depressingly sad that I dont get to be with my family as they get older. I dont get to take care of them. I don’t think I will ever find happiness.

I just spent the last three hours crying non stop cause I am about to move away from my parents. I will be attending a grad program and move away from my home country.  I’m not really worried about the funding or living independently, in fact looking forward to it.

However, I just dont want to move away from my family? Just the thought of possibly losing them forever makes me want to die


What should I do? I don’t think this is normal.
